title: Which products survive this filter?

scenes.narration: Which products survive this stock filter?
Here's a quick CAP challenge. Our prepared inventory service exposes three products. Predict which rows remain when stock is greater than zero.
Read the CSV: keyboard, twelve; dock, seven; monitor arm, zero. Keep those stock counts in mind before checking the answer.
Run npm run demo. This first query lists all three products by title. Which names would your stock filter keep?
Here's the checked result: Mechanical Keyboard and USB-C Dock. Both have positive stock. Monitor Arm has zero, so it is excluded.
The cards show title and stock; the actual response also includes ID. This is local sample data.
Try the project and its five checks. Predict another threshold, then test your answer.

publicationText:
Quick CAP challenge: which products survive a stock-greater-than-zero filter?

The sample CSV starts with Mechanical Keyboard (12), USB-C Dock (7), and Monitor Arm (0). Predict the result before the reveal. The checked query keeps the keyboard and dock.

The video cards show title and stock; the real response also includes ID. This is a local inventory sample with five live checks, not production data.
